name: boxes — fast debug cycle
comment: Just colors_widths.pb: 3 meshes with per-face colours and edges, 1 polyline, 1 point. 8 KB, parses in ~3 ms, so a reload costs nothing. This is the scene to point DEMO_SCENE_URL at while iterating on line rendering - the Stanford meshes carry a serialized halfedge and take tens of seconds each to parse, which is a terrible debug loop.
